name: Supleq Smart Clicks
description: Your recorded up-arrow, fast-spam, and spacebar sounds with random press/release samples and automatic 8 CPS switching.

main-title.name: Supleq Smart Clicks
main-title.description: Plays your actual recorded key presses/releases in levels. Use Geode to disable the mod at any time.

fast-enabled.name: Use faster samples during spam
fast-enabled.description: When Up Arrow press rate exceeds the threshold, randomly play sounds cut from the fast-spam recording.

fast-threshold.name: Fast spam threshold (CPS)
fast-threshold.description: Switch above this number of Up Arrow presses per second. Spacebar has its own sounds.
